title: feat: apply
defect: terraform apply -lock=false on leftover state so two CIs provision the same billing SKU twice
missing: two concurrent applies must not create a second Chargeable sku resource
fix: require -lock=true and a remote backend lock; fail if lock is skipped

title: feat: up
defect: pulumi up --refresh=false leaves leftover stack outputs stale so the next up recreates RDS and double-bills
missing: stale outputs must not recreate an already-provisioned RDS instance
fix: refresh before replace plus protect on the RDS URN

title: feat: claim
defect: Composition updatePolicy=Manual so a leftover Claim still points at a deleted Composite and Crossplane provisions a second billed cluster
missing: deleting the Composite must not leave a Claim that recreates a second billed cluster
fix: updatePolicy=Automatic plus orphan:false and a unique claim name lock

title: feat: hook
defect: pre-install Job lacks hook-delete-policy before-hook-creation so a leftover Job reruns and double-charges
missing: a leftover hook Job must not Charge.create a second time on upgrade
fix: hook-delete-policy: before-hook-creation and an Idempotency-Key on the Job name

title: feat: overlay
defect: prod overlay omits namePrefix so leftover patches hit the staging Deployment and prod traffic charges staging SKUs
missing: prod patches must not mutate the staging Deployment name
fix: namePrefix: prod- plus a kustomize build test that asserts distinct names

title: feat: merge
defect: std.mergePatch leftover concatenates containers[] so two charge sidecars run and both POST /charge
missing: merge must replace the charge container list not concatenate a second sidecar
fix: std.mergePatch with explicit containers replace or std.mapWithKey overwrite

title: feat: allow
defect: package authz leftover reads input.user without tenant isolation so deny is skipped and any tenant charges any SKU
missing: allow must be false when input.tenant != resource.tenant
fix: deny by default plus input.tenant == resource.tenant in allow

title: feat: permit
defect: Cedar permit leftover omits context.ip so when.isInRange is vacuously true and every caller may Charge.create
missing: permit must fail closed when context.ip is absent
fix: require context.ip and when { context.ip.isInRange(office) }; forbid if missing

title: feat: check
defect: OpenFGA Write leftover then Check without HIGHER_CONSISTENCY so a just-deleted tuple still allows the charge
missing: Check after delete must not allow the same SKU charge
fix: ConsistencyPreference HIGHER_CONSISTENCY on Check after Write/Delete

title: feat: copyfrom
defect: sqlc :copyfrom leftover inserts invoice rows with no ON CONFLICT so a retry duplicates GMV
missing: retry of CopyFrom must not insert a second invoice_id
fix: COPY with ON CONFLICT (invoice_id) DO NOTHING or a unique index plus upsert

title: feat: debit
defect: Prisma $transaction leftover uses default isolation so two debit txs both read 100 and write 50, overdrafting
missing: two concurrent debits must not both commit against the same pre-debit snapshot
fix: isolationLevel Serializable or UPDATE ... SET bal = bal - n WHERE bal >= n

title: feat: hook
defect: ent MutateFunc leftover returns next without wrapping so a serializable debit hook never runs and two cashiers overdraft
missing: the debit hook must run on every Mutation or the cashier path must fail closed
fix: return hook.On(next, ent.OpUpdate) and assert the hook fired in tests

title: feat: loader
defect: DataLoader leftover caches SKU by id across tenants so tenant B is billed tenant A's price
missing: loader keys must be tenant-scoped or cache must not leak prices across tenants
fix: cacheKeyFn: (id, tenant) and a new DataLoader per request

title: feat: stream
defect: gRPC client stream leftover has no deadline so a retry after a hang double-sends ChargeCreate
missing: a hung stream retry must not emit a second ChargeCreate
fix: context.WithTimeout plus idempotency metadata on ChargeCreate

title: feat: superjson
defect: tRPC superjson leftover deserializes a fold-night ISO as UTC so the appointment is stored an hour late and double-booked
missing: fold-night ISO must round-trip in the original offset not as naive UTC
fix: transformer that preserves offset or store instants as epoch ms

title: feat: resume
defect: WebSocket resume leftover ignores lastSeq so a reconnect replays PLACE_ORDER and double-fills
missing: resume must ack lastSeq and must not replay an already-filled PLACE_ORDER
fix: store lastSeq server-side and skip events <= lastSeq

title: feat: sse
defect: SSE handler leftover ignores Last-Event-ID so EventSource reconnects replay charge events already captured
missing: reconnect must not emit a charge id already sent
fix: honor Last-Event-ID and skip ids <= cursor

title: feat: retain
defect: MQTT publish leftover uses QoS 0 plus retain so a stale price is delivered after a newer quote and the buyer is overcharged
missing: a retained stale price must not beat a later quote
fix: QoS 1 plus retain replace on the same topic and a version field

title: feat: nbf
defect: JWT Verify leftover skips nbf so a not-before token is accepted early and a pre-sale charge captures
missing: tokens with nbf in the future must not authorize Charge.create
fix: require nbf claim and reject now < nbf - leeway

title: feat: footer
defect: PASETO v4 leftover treats footer kid as advisory so an attacker swaps kid and the old key still decrypts a charge grant
missing: footer kid must bind to the key that verified the payload
fix: parse footer first, select key, verify, then reject if footer.kid != key.id

title: feat: caveat
defect: macaroon leftover verifies signature but skips first-party sku= caveat so a token minted for SKU-A charges SKU-B
missing: discharge must fail when the sku caveat does not match the charged SKU
fix: walk caveats and require sku==request.sku before capture

title: feat: hash
defect: argon2 leftover uses Type I so a side-channel on leftover password verify lets an attacker mint a matching hash for support login
missing: Type I must not be used for password hashing on the support login path
fix: argon2id with time>=2 memory>=64MiB and unique salt per row

title: feat: bcrypt
defect: bcrypt leftover hashes only the first 72 bytes so two distinct long secrets collide and a leftover suffix unlocks the cashier
missing: secrets longer than 72 bytes must not collide on the cashier login
fix: pre-hash with SHA-256 then bcrypt, or reject length>72

title: feat: scrypt
defect: scrypt leftover uses N=2^10 and a global salt so two cashiers share a derived key and one leftover password opens both wallets
missing: each wallet must have a unique salt and N large enough to resist offline guess
fix: per-row salt plus N>=2^15 r=8 p=1

title: feat: replacing
defect: ReplacingMergeTree leftover query omits FINAL so duplicate version rows SUM into GMV and finance double-collects
missing: SUM must not count superseded versions of the same order_id
fix: SELECT ... FINAL or argMax(amount, ver) GROUP BY order_id

title: feat: rollup
defect: Druid leftover ingestion rollup=true with metric leftover count plus query SUM(count) double-counts the same charge event
missing: query must not SUM an already-rolled-up count into a second billed total
fix: query the rollup metric without a second SUM or disable query-time re-aggregation

title: feat: upsert
defect: Pinot leftover upsertMode NONE so a replayed charge event appends a second row and GMV doubles
missing: replayed primary keys must replace not append
fix: upsertMode FULL plus primaryKeyColumns charge_id

title: feat: ackwait
defect: NATS JetStream leftover AckWait shorter than Stripe RTT so the message is redelivered and Charge.create runs twice
missing: AckWait must outlast the Stripe call or the handler must be idempotent on charge_id
fix: AckWait >= 30s plus Idempotency-Key = msg.Nats-Msg-Id

title: feat: producer
defect: Kafka producer leftover enable.idempotence=false so a retry after acks=all timeout publishes a second charge record
missing: producer retry must not append a second record for the same charge_id
fix: enable.idempotence=true transactional.id and a compact key=charge_id

title: feat: txn
defect: Redpanda leftover producer has no transactional.id so an aborted txn still appears to consumers and a charge is captured
missing: aborted transactions must not be visible as captured charges
fix: transactional.id plus isolation.level=read_committed on the consumer

title: feat: can
defect: Temporal leftover ContinueAsNew runs Charge.create in the workflow function so the new run repeats the side effect
missing: ContinueAsNew must not Charge.create a SKU already charged in the parent run
fix: move Charge.create to an activity with idempotency keyed by workflow.ID

title: feat: child
defect: Cadence leftover ParentClosePolicy ABANDON so a cancelled parent leaves a child that still Charge.create after refund
missing: cancelling the parent must not leave a child that charges after refund
fix: ParentClosePolicy TERMINATE plus a refund compensation on cancel

title: feat: fork
defect: Conductor leftover FORK Join timeout retries the whole fork so both branches Charge.create again
missing: Join timeout must not restart a branch that already charged
fix: per-task retryCount=0 on Charge plus a JOIN failure that compensates instead of restart

title: feat: host
defect: WASM leftover host import Charge.create is unmetered so a guest loop leftover double-charges until timeout
missing: guest must not call Charge.create more than once per invoice_id
fix: host-side idempotency map plus fuel/meter on the import

title: feat: sandbox
defect: Lua leftover sandbox still exposes os.execute so a template leftover shells curl to Charge.create twice
missing: sandboxed Lua must not os.execute a second charge
fix: nil os.execute and a host-only charge API with idempotency

title: feat: cel
defect: CEL leftover optional.?user.banned short-circuits to null which is truthy-not-false so deny is skipped and a banned user charges
missing: missing banned must fail closed not skip deny
fix: has(user.banned) && user.banned == true as deny; default false allow

title: feat: closed
defect: CUE leftover definition is open so an extra sku field leftover is accepted and a hidden SKU is billed
missing: unknown sku fields must be rejected
fix: close({sku: string, cents: int}) and cue vet in CI

title: feat: importstr
defect: Jsonnet leftover importstr of a charge API key concatenates two keys so the second leftover key captures a second charge
missing: importstr must not concatenate a second API key into Charge.create
fix: single-key secret plus std.manifestJsonMinified without concat

title: feat: tomap
defect: Dhall leftover toMap with a type hole leftover infers Text so cents become a leftover string and the parser bills 100x
missing: cents must stay Natural not Text or the billed amount must not jump 100x
fix: toMap with an explicit { mapKey : Text, mapValue : Natural }

title: feat: fetchurl
defect: nix leftover fetchurl sha256 = "" so a leftover tarball swap injects a charge binary that double-posts
missing: empty sha256 must not accept a substituted charge binary
fix: fixed-output derivation with a real sri hash and allowSubstitutes=false in CI

title: feat: gexp
defect: Guix leftover ungexp splices a charge phase twice so the builder leftover POSTs /charge twice
missing: the charge phase must run once per package
fix: single ungexp of the phase and a builder test that counts POSTs

title: feat: concretize
defect: Spack leftover concretizer allows a hash flip so CI leftover installs a different charge CLI that double-captures
missing: concretized hash must pin the charge CLI bit-for-bit
fix: spack.lock commit plus --dirty fail if spec hash changes

title: feat: attach
defect: DuckDB leftover ATTACH without READ_ONLY so a leftover writer mutates the warehouse copy and GMV is double-counted locally
missing: the attached warehouse must not accept local writes that duplicate GMV
fix: ATTACH ... (READ_ONLY) plus a unique order_id constraint

title: feat: wal
defect: SQLite leftover checkpoint PASSIVE during a refund txn so a crash leaves the capture and drops the refund
missing: a crash mid-refund must not leave a captured charge without the refund row
fix: checkpoint TRUNCATE only after COMMIT and a single txn for capture+refund

title: feat: share
defect: MotherDuck leftover SHARE uses a stale snapshot so finance leftover SUMs yesterday's captures again
missing: the share must not re-sum a snapshot whose captures were already invoiced
fix: SHARE at a named snapshot id plus invoice watermark

title: feat: wire
defect: Wire leftover ProviderSet binds ChargeClient twice so leftover Init charges with two clients and double-captures
missing: ChargeClient must be provided once per process
fix: one ProviderSet and wiretest that panics on duplicate bind

title: feat: withenv
defect: Dagger leftover withEnv puts the charge API key in plaintext so a leftover cache volume replays Charge.create
missing: the API key must not be in withEnv or the cache must not replay Charge.create
fix: withSecretVariable plus cache mounts that exclude env

title: feat: onstart
defect: fx leftover Invoke plus OnStart both Charge.create so process boot leftover double-captures the leftover SKU
missing: boot must Charge.create at most once
fix: only OnStart or only Invoke, with a sync.Once around Charge.create
